metadata.review_policy: 75% silent; shared concentration1.5 and anchored value frequency; pilot price penalty0.2 and reviewer spread0.22
metadata.purchase_price_basis: Actual selected whole shirt pack reference in authored history, not a retailer quote.
metadata.relative_price_basis: Exact recipe and pack factors apply equally to paid/global100/500 bounds; anchor denominator400. Complete current source aliases required before topics.

metadata.required_context_capability: Mandatory explicit-original/source-semantic V2 T-shirt factory with privately retained complete manufacture and independently actual executed market stage; both catalogue and owner.
metadata.market_stage: Accepted stage exactly once after profile, before recipe; no SKU/owner redraw.
metadata.public_assertion_adoption: Independently accepted source-bound local companion; formal producer/export/default/site/task/training excluded.
metadata.price_basis: One-shirt model anchor*recipe_numerator/4; selected whole pack anchor*recipe_numerator*pack_numerator/40; exact per-shirt pack discount.
metadata.status_projection: Source-qualified unknown/NA projection after actual validation; no entity normalization or permissive public scalar eval.
metadata.heuristic_status: Two shallow fictional ordinary cotton-jersey T-shirt constructions; no technical/medical/thermal/UV/measured-fit/care-performance guarantees.
